Vacancy for Junior Clerk cum Data Entry Operator
Thursday, 23 January 2025
4768 Hits
The applications are invited in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials for 5 vacant posts. The applicants must submit their educational qualifications, experience certificates, and other necessary documents, ensuring they reach the Dean Office, MGIMS, Sewagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 on or before 06/02/2025. Those who have already applied as per the reference newspaper Times of India dated 14/08/2024 need not to apply again.
click here to download the form
Junior Clerk cum Data Entry Operator:
05 Posts – (1- SC, 1- OBC, 1 – EWS, 2- Open)
Qualification & Experience:
Graduation from Govt. a recognized Institute approved by University, MSCIT with proficiency in operating computers and two years’ experience as Clerk in a Medical College or in a Hospital with 500 or more beds.
Salary:
As per Kasturba Health Society’s Rules
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for General Candidate/ between 18-43 for reserved candidate
Note:
1. Application to be submitted to the Dean, MGIMS for the above mentioned posts
Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
Dean reserves right to reject any or all application as deemed appropriate
Decision of Selection Committee will be final and binding.
Institute reserves the right to adopt varying selection process for different post.
Only eligible candidates will be called for Written / Skill test and shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification / Interview
Medical Superintendent
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
